decisions.title: This section's decisions

decisions.unavailable: This section's decisions could not be read.

decisions.propose: Propose a rule from this conversation

decisions.propose_failed: The proposal could not be made.
decisions.comment_placeholder: What is wrong, or what would you do instead?
decisions.comment_note: Your words are kept exactly as written and change nothing on their own. They become a proposal only after a person reviews them.

bom.group_unassigned: Not asked for by any element

warning.insufficient_post_length: Post {element} needs {required_mm} {u} but {sku} is only {available_mm} {u} long — choose a longer post

warning.gate_kit_width_mismatch: Gate kit {sku} fits a {kit_width_mm} {u} opening but {element} is {opening_width_mm} {u} — the wrong gate would be priced

warning.clear_gap_exceeded: A gap of {value_mm} {u} in section {run_id} exceeds the {limit_mm} {u} limit ({n} bay(s)) — narrow the spacing or widen the members
warning.rail_separation_insufficient: In section {run_id} the rail above the bottom one is only {value_mm} {u} up, under the {limit_mm} {u} anti-climb limit ({n} bay(s))
warning.pattern_residual_large: Section {run_id} leaves {value_mm} {u} of the pattern unfilled, over the {limit_mm} {u} tolerance ({n} bay(s))
error.clear_gap_exceeded: No strategy was generated: a gap of {value_mm} {u} in section {run_id} exceeds the hard limit of {limit_mm} {u}.

assembly.hint: The run as it is set out, and one panel as it is assembled. Pick a bay above to open it below.
assembly.macro_hint: Click a bay or a post to select it; the panel beside it follows.
assembly.micro_hint: Click a member to find it in every bay that carries it.
assembly.no_run: No fence has been generated yet — draw a topology and generate a strategy to see it standing up.
assembly.nominal_post: Post widths are drawn to a nominal: the catalog does not declare a face width for every post.
assembly.gate_height_unknown: A gate opening is drawn without a leaf where no neighbouring bay states a height.
assembly.simplified: Panels are drawn as blocks on this run — too many members to read at this scale.
warning.no_item_covers_part_spec: No product in the catalogue covers the cap specification of {model} at station {station_mm} — the post there is uncapped
warning.no_item_covers_post_spec: No product in the catalogue covers the post specification of {model} — this bay is drawn at its centre-to-centre width rather than the opening between two posts
error.decision_ref_needs_run: A decision is numbered per generation, so asking for {decision_ref} without saying which run it belongs to would mix comments about different decisions. Ask for one run's conversation, or for the whole project's.
error.model_changed: These assembly steps belong to {model_ref}, and this panel was built to {panel_model_ref}. A step names slots, so laying one version's instructions over another version's panel would describe a panel nobody built.
error.no_item_covers_part_spec: No product in the catalogue covers the {role} specification of model {model} at station {station_mm}. A fence cannot be built without a post there: add a product that meets the specification, or change the model's {slot_key} slot.
error.post_spec_conflict: The bays either side of station {station_mm} are built to different models ({models}), and no post in the catalogue satisfies both specifications. Both apply to the one post that stands between them, so either the models must agree or the boundary must move.
error.post_routing_mismatch: The panel at station {station_mm} puts its rails at {wanted}, and the posts of model {model} are routed at {routed}. The holes are punched at the factory, so this fence cannot be assembled — change the height, the rail count, or the post product.
error.sku_not_eligible: {sku} is not one of the products the {slot_key} slot of this panel can be built from, so the panel was not priced with it. Choose one of the products offered for that part.
assembly.what_if_note: Nothing here is saved: generate to build it.
assembly.preview_failed: This panel could not be priced just now.
assembly.no_options_here: This bay comes from a run generated before fence models, so its parts have no product options to show.
